label: Teltonika ALTOS CAP700
description: Wi-Fi 7 5G fixed-wireless access point: 1x 2.5G WAN/LAN, 1x 1 GbE LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the ALTOS CAP700 datasheet: **1x WAN/LAN port, 10/100/1000/2500 Mbps** and **1x LAN port, 10/100/1000 Mbps**, with a 5G modem and Wi-Fi 7 radios. **The two ports are not the same speed** - 2.5G on the WAN/LAN port, gigabit on the LAN port - so the 2.5G path is only end to end if the fast host is the one on the first port.
